name: Sodium monofluorophosphate
description: Sodium monofluorophosphate (CAS 7631-97-2 ) is an inorganic fluoride salt used as an active ingredient in dental care products and pharmaceutical formulations. It delivers controlled fluoride release to support enamel remineralization. This compound serves as a regulated active in oral health applications across global markets. In oral care, it is the active fluoride source in toothpastes, gels, and mouth rinses formulated to meet regulatory fluoride content requirements. These formulations are designed for markets including the EU, US, and Japan. Pharmaceutical-grade applications include fluoride supplement tablets and dental treatment preparations where precise dosing and purity documentation are required. Such documentation is essential for regulatory submission in various jurisdictions. In specialty personal care formulations, it is incorporated into professional dental products and whitening systems for enhanced performance. It offers a formulation advantage over alternative fluoride salts due to its compatibility with abrasive or peroxide-containing bases. Sodium monofluorophosphate is supplied as a white crystalline powder for industrial use. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade specifications meeting USP and BP standards. Food-grade material is also available for markets where oral care actives require food-standard compliance for safety. Packaging options typically range from kilogram-scale laboratory quantities to bulk metric-ton supply.
